title: convolvulus rottlerianus subsp. stocksii
intro: Convolvulus rottlerianus subsp. stocksii, commonly known as the 'Kathal' or 'Tree spinach', is a species of flowering plant in the Convolvulaceae family. This plant has been found to offer various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health due to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Convolvulus rottlerianus subsp. stocksii include its use in traditional medicine to treat conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and wounds. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
